entries.evidence: No adapter exists anywhere in this codebase that allocates corporate/shared people-cost overhead onto direct campus payroll to form a 'consolidated people cost' metric (confirmed V10-RC2 Gate 5, reconfirmed V10-RC2.1 Gate 5, reconfirmed this phase). Two DISTINCT DRE-level fixed cost lines exist tagged costLineCategory='corporate_allocation' — dreLineId 'corporativo_bu' and 'rateio_corporativo' (dreLineItemMap.ts, populated with real Finance annual values in dreAnnualAssumptionSourceData.ts, feeding calculateDre()'s EBITDA) — but these are Finance-provided fixed P&L expense lines, directScenarioDriver=false, scenarioSensitivity=independent_of_board_decision_levers: NOT headcount-driven, NOT a function of payroll, and NOT a payroll-to-corporate-cost consolidation adapter. They must not be conflated with the payroll-side 'corporate allocation' this gate concerns.
